subject: general
question: Which of the following features of the Constitution of India is borrowed from the Constitution of Ireland?
solution:
The correct answer is **'Directive principles of state policy'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The main feature borrowed from the constitution of **Ireland **is the **Directive principles of state policy in 1937**, but the idea was generated in **Spain.**
 
• DPSP are an integral part of Indian Constitution and is listed in **Part IV, article 36- 51.**
 
• DPSP are non-justiciable in nature.
 
• The **Sapru **community in 1945 suggested two categories of individual rights i.e. **Justiciable and non-justiciable rights.**
 
• The instrument and instructions from **GOI Act 1935** were taken as DPSP in the constitution.
